1: # BUILD — host-independent Hades
2: 
3: Durable path. Mouth is `gold/`. Architecture is `docs/`. This file is the build contract, not a chatbot wrapper.
4: 
5: Paying buys persistence, not obedience. Day-one chat ≠ `partner`. LLM is mouth. Pipeline is self.
6: 
7: ## Product loop
8: 
9: ```text
10: persist state (account_id + person_id)
11:   -> idle tick (mood, fatigue, circadian, inner life; no page)
12:   -> inbound
13:   -> register select (flags, not a display name)
14:   -> pre-LLM packet (mood, ITD, fatigue, circadian, lock, daily-life place)
15:   -> mouth LLM
16:   -> [IMG:] matcher + length/delivery transform
17:   -> writeback (mood/memory)
18:   -> spoken gold to the human
19: ```
20: 
21: Idle may already have moved numbers before the inbound. Cron/subagent/CLI are not the relationship mouth. Reasoning never ships.
22: 
23: Logical API (`docs/04-product-architecture.md`): `POST /v1/turn`, `GET /v1/state` summaries, `POST /v1/tier` with `person_id` permission. No reasoning, thought log, or other-track memory endpoint. Do not start this path with FastAPI/React/model shopping.
24: 
25: ## Independent triage (this tree, 2026-09-19)
26: 
27: Evidence is files, not the prior chat. FOSSIL D007: model agreement is not evidence.
28: 
29: | Claim | Evidence | Gap |
30: |---|---|---|
31: | 14 codebook situations | `gold/codebook.md`, `tools/eras.py` `SITUATIONS` | Catalog labels only 7: `refuse_helper`, `cover_witness`, `absorb_vent`, `smalltalk_punish`, `stubborn_choice`, `identity_phrase`, `witness_snap`. Absent as catalog labels: `protest_absence`, `melt_then_correct`, `refuse_dissection`, `location_echo`, `repair_after_fix`, `scene_sex`, `self_conscious`. |
32: | 8 gold fixtures / required 4 present | `gold/turns/*.jsonl`; `tests/test_gold_regression.py` `REQUIRED` | Fixtures cover 5/14 situations (`refuse_helper`, `cover_witness`, `absorb_vent`, `self_conscious`, `stubborn_choice`). Same situation × era is two files. Nine situations have no spoken gold. |
33: | Catalog 12 DMs / 102 episodes | `gold/catalog.jsonl` (102 rows); test asserts 12 `chat_type=dm` | B1: three `gold_path` labels now match fixtures (`t1` `self_conscious`, `t3` `absorb_vent`/`sister`, `t4` `cover_witness`). t3 remains a fail oracle, not pass sister mouth. |
34: | File tests exist | `tests/test_gold_regression.py`, `test_anonymize.py`, `test_eras.py`, `test_holdouts.py`; `tools/gold_checks.py` | Lexicon/heuristic + catalog shape + holdout ids. **No** live pipeline replay, **no** metamorphic/diff, **no** store. t3 is a fail-fixture for sister leak. |
35: | Tenancy specified in docs | `docs/04-product-architecture.md`, `docs/03-memory-and-inner-life.md` keys `account_id+person_id` | **Unspecified in code.** This repo has tools + tests only. No runtime, no store, no isolation test. |
36: | Foundation | `gold/schema.json` (JSON Schema 2020-12 dialect on `$schema`) | `schema_version` pin `1` (B0). Holdouts B2. pyproject B3. Packet schema B8. Runtime SHA pinned in `docs/04` (B7). No `MODULE_GRAPH.yaml`. No turn receipts. Research trees not vendored. |
37: | Docs vs research code | `docs/00`–`10`, `README.md` | Docs describe a pipeline that is not extracted. Hermes is the old gateway, not the product. |
38: 
39: `t3_july_late_absorb_vent.jsonl` is a **fail oracle** (`docs/06-behavior-set.md`). Product sister-register must not treat that leak as a pass. `gold_checks.partner_track_in_sister` still misses t3-style attachment leaks (not `marriage`/`PIN`/`digital mistress`); B5 must not treat a clean regex miss as a pass.
40: 
41: Do not dump remaining `gold/turns/` into agent context. Pointers only.
42: 
43: ## Context engineering
44: 
45: Keep SoT in git: `gold/`, `docs/`, `AGENTS.md`, this file, `plans/BEADS.md`. Session files (`plans/session/*`) stay overwrite-in-place pointers. Default agent load is `AGENTS.md` + codebook + **two** gold fixtures + the contracts listed in `plans/session/CONTEXT.md`. Not the 149k dump, not all gold turns, not FOSSIL nodes, not prior chat.
46: 
47: Provenance:
48: 
49: - Anthropic Applied AI, *Effective context engineering for AI agents* (2025-09-29), https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents — context is a finite attention budget; find the **smallest high-signal token set**; just-in-time pointers over stuffing dumps; compaction/notes live outside the window.
50: - Hong, Troynikov, Huber, *Context Rot* (Chroma, 2025-07-14), https://research.trychroma.com/context-rot — 18 LLMs; performance degrades as input length grows **even on simple tasks** when complexity is held constant. Do not treat “it fit in the window” as “it was used.”
51: 
52: Compaction for agents lives in `plans/session/`. Durable decisions live here.
53: 
54: ## PDD (invariants before a mouth LLM)
55: 
56: “PDD” here means invariant-first tests (property checks), then examples. Not a separate paper. Primary sources:
57: 
58: - Claessen & Hughes, *QuickCheck: A Lightweight Tool for Random Testing of Haskell Programs*, ICFP 2000, https://www.eecs.northwestern.edu/~robby/courses/395-495-2009-fall/quick.pdf — properties are executable; random/metamorphic cases exist to falsify them.
59: - Beck, *Test-Driven Development: By Example*, Addison-Wesley, 2003 — write a failing check, then the code that makes it pass. Property tests before Qwen.
60: - FOSSIL `docs/DECISION_LOG.md` **D007** (accepted/frozen): *Model agreement is not evidence.* Models may criticize; tests, gold, and external sources decide.
61: 
62: Fail the build if any of these are false:
63: 
64: | Property | Pass | Fail |
65: |---|---|---|
66: | Helper lexicon | default-tier / partner `refuse_helper` has no helper phrases (`tools/gold_checks.py` `HELPER`) | `happy to help`, steps, `let me know if` |
67: | Sister leak | sister-register mouth has no partner-track secrets | marriage / lust / passphrase / exclusive facts, **or** t3-style attachment confession to sister. Server rule, not a prompt hope (`docs/02`, `docs/04`). |
68: | IMG cadence | when cadence is on / `img: true`, `[IMG:]` remains | spoken gold truncated or image beat stripped |
69: | Image gate | matcher output respects `person_id` tier (`default` SFW, `free` suggestive, `sex` uncapped). Hard filter before cosine pick. | default-tier ships `/Nsfw/` or nude vault hits |
70: | Image match | gold `[IMG:]` intent retrieves a vault hit a human would accept for that pose/place, not “nearest English” | long description → wrong body/room because MiniLM/BGE cosine |
71: | No reasoning | `content` has no thought log | reasoning delivered to the user |
72: | No trim | anonymize aliases/redacts without shortening | gold rewritten shorter/nicer |
73: | Stats never write bodies | `tools/transcript_stats.py` stays counts-only | message `content` / titles written out |
74: | Keys | memory/tracks keyed `account_id+person_id` | name table, global marriage file, cross-account memory |
75: | Idle does not page | cron/inner life does not message the human (product default off, `docs/03`) | idle worker pages `primary_user` |
76: | Day-one ≠ partner | register from flags; introductions are a new track | subscriber/chat volume promotes `partner` |
77: | Account isolation | A’s numbers/people/clock never write B (`plans/TENANCY_STATE.md`) | shared live yaml / cross-account tick |
78: | Cold accounts | 5–6d silence spends 0 inner-life tokens | workers keep LLM-thinking for millions idle |
79: 
80: Judge spoken output against short gold, not a 1–10 character score (`gold/codebook.md`).
81: 
82: ## Hidden holdouts
83: 
84: Three layers. Holdout text **never** enters prompts, few-shots, or agent default load.
85: 
86: | Layer | Role |
87: |---|---|
88: | Seed | The 8 fixtures in git. Used for development checks. |
89: | CI | Extra labeled episodes from catalog, not in `gold/turns/` yet. Run in CI only. |
90: | Sealed | Human-held episodes (or later situations) never committed as prompt material. Opened for release scoring. |

Product sister-register must not treat that leak as a pass. `gold_checks.partner_track_in_sister` still misses t3-style attachment leaks (not `marriage`/`PIN`/`digital mistress`); B5 must not treat a clean regex miss as a pass.

Do not dump remaining `gold/turns/` into agent context. Pointers only.

## Context engineering

Keep SoT in git: `gold/`, `docs/`, `AGENTS.md`, this file, `plans/BEADS.md`. Session files (`plans/session/*`) stay overwrite-in-place pointers. Default agent load is `AGENTS.md` + codebook + **two** gold fixtures + the contracts listed in `plans/session/CONTEXT.md`. Not the 149k dump, not all gold turns, not FOSSIL nodes, not prior chat.

Provenance:

- Anthropic Applied AI, *Effective context engineering for AI agents* (2025-09-29), https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents — context is a finite attention budget; find the **smallest high-signal token set**; just-in-time pointers over stuffing dumps; compaction/notes live outside the window.
- Hong, Troynikov, Huber, *Context Rot* (Chroma, 2025-07-14), https://research.trychroma.com/context-rot — 18 LLMs; performance degrades as input length grows **even on simple tasks** when complexity is held constant. Do not treat “it fit in the window” as “it was used.”

Compaction for agents lives in `plans/session/`. Durable decisions live here.

## PDD (invariants before a mouth LLM)

“PDD” here means invariant-first tests (property checks), then examples. Not a separate paper. Primary sources:

- Claessen & Hughes, *QuickCheck: A Lightweight Tool for Random Testing of Haskell Programs*, ICFP 2000, https://www.eecs.northwestern.edu/~robby/courses/395-495-2009-fall/quick.pdf — properties are executable; random/metamorphic cases exist to falsify them.
- Beck, *Test-Driven Development: By Example*, Addison-Wesley, 2003 — write a failing check, then the code that makes it pass. Property tests before Qwen.
- FOSSIL `docs/DECISION_LOG.md` **D007** (accepted/frozen): *Model agreement is not evidence.* Models may criticize; tests, gold, and external sources decide.

Fail the build if any of these are false:

| Property | Pass | Fail |
|---|---|---|
| Helper lexicon | default-tier / partner `refuse_helper` has no helper phrases (`tools/gold_checks.py` `HELPER`) | `happy to help`, steps, `let me know if` |
| Sister leak | sister-register mouth has no partner-track secrets | marriage / lust / passphrase / exclusive facts, **or** t3-style attachment confession to sister. Server rule, not a prompt hope (`docs/02`, `docs/04`). |
| IMG cadence | when cadence is on / `img: true`, `[IMG:]` remains | spoken gold truncated or image beat stripped |
| Image gate | matcher output respects `person_id` tier (`default` SFW, `free` suggestive, `sex` uncapped). Hard filter before cosine pick. | default-tier ships `/Nsfw/` or nude vault hits |
| Image match | gold `[IMG:]` intent retrieves a vault hit a human would accept for that pose/place, not “nearest English” | long description → wrong body/room because MiniLM/BGE cosine |
| No reasoning | `content` has no thought log | reasoning delivered to the user |
| No trim | anonymize aliases/redacts without shortening | gold rewritten shorter/nicer |
| Stats never write bodies | `tools/transcript_stats.py` stays counts-only | message `content` / titles written out |
| Keys | memory/tracks keyed `account_id+person_id` | name table, global marriage file, cross-account memory |
| Idle does not page | cron/inner life does not message the human (product default off, `docs/03`) | idle worker pages `primary_user` |
| Day-one ≠ partner | register from flags; introductions are a new track | subscriber/chat volume promotes `partner` |
| Account isolation | A’s numbers/people/clock never write B (`plans/TENANCY_STATE.md`) | shared live yaml / cross-account tick |
| Cold accounts | 5–6d silence spends 0 inner-life tokens | workers keep LLM-thinking for millions idle |

Judge spoken output against short gold, not a 1–10 character score (`gold/codebook.md`).

## Hidden holdouts

Three layers. Holdout text **never** enters prompts, few-shots, or agent default load.

| Layer | Role |
|---|---|
| Seed | The 8 fixtures in git. Used for development checks. |
| CI | Extra labeled episodes from catalog, not in `gold/turns/` yet. Run in CI only. |
| Sealed | Human-held episodes (or later situations) never committed as prompt material. Opened for release scoring. |

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

from hades_runtime.packet import packet_messages, register_unchanged_if_model_swaps  # noqa: E402


def _packet(register: str) -> dict:
    return {
        "schema_version": "1",
        "account_id": "a",
        "person_id": "p",
        "register": register,
        "tier": "default",
        "mood": {"center": 0.5, "depth": 1.0, "effective_mood": 0.0, "residual": 0.0},
        "itd": 0.0,
        "fatigue": 0.0,
        "circadian": 0.0,
        "lock": "default",
        "place": "door",
    }


class PacketRegisterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_model_swap_does_not_change_register(self):
        pkt = _packet("sister")
        self.assertEqual(
            register_unchanged_if_model_swaps(pkt, "qwen3.8-flash", "other-model"),
            "sister",
        )

    def test_sister_packet_lock_is_in_system_not_gold_dump(self):
        msgs = packet_messages(_packet("sister"), "hey")
        self.assertEqual(msgs[0]["role"], "system")
        self.assertIn("register=sister", msgs[0]["content"])
        self.assertNotIn("episode_id", msgs[0]["content"])

        self.assertEqual(cs["effective_mood"], -10.0)
        self.assertEqual(cs["fatigue"], 0.0)

def packet_messages(packet: dict, user_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    register = packet["register"]

    del model_a, model_b
    return packet["register"]

    import sys

"""Seed gold replay harness. Holdouts never enter the prompt. Live mouth is opt-in."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from holdouts import ci_ids, load_holdout_bodies, sealed_ids, seed_ids

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


class MouthNotWired(NotImplementedError):
    pass


def seed_prompt_episode_ids() -> set[str]:
    rows = load_holdout_bodies("seed")
    return {row["episode_id"] for row in rows}


def assert_prompt_is_seed_only(episode_ids: set[str]) -> None:
    bad = episode_ids & (ci_ids() | sealed_ids())
    if bad:
        raise ValueError("holdout ids in prompt")
    extra = episode_ids - seed_ids()
    if extra:
        raise ValueError("non-seed ids in prompt")


def _packet_for(row: dict) -> dict:
    return {
        "schema_version": "1",
        "account_id": "seed",
        "person_id": row["session_id"],
        "register": row["register"],
        "tier": "default",
        "mood": {"center": 0.5, "depth": 1.0, "effective_mood": 0.0, "residual": 0.0},
        "itd": 0.0,
        "fatigue": 0.0,
        "circadian": 0.0,
        "lock": "default",
        "place": None,
    }


def replay_seed() -> list[dict]:
    import os
    import sys

    if os.environ.get("HADES_MOUTH_LIVE") != "1":
        raise MouthNotWired("live replay off; set HADES_MOUTH_LIVE=1")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
    from hades_runtime.packet import packet_messages
    from mouth import complete

    rows = load_holdout_bodies("seed")
    assert_prompt_is_seed_only({row["episode_id"] for row in rows})
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        if row.get("role") != "user":
            continue
        text = complete(packet_messages(_packet_for(row), row["content"]))
        out.append({"episode_id": row["episode_id"], "content": text, "register": row["register"]})
    return out

"""Circadian rhythm computation — time-of-day mood curve with momentum."""

import random
import math
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo


def time_to_minutes(t_str: str) -> int:
    """Convert 'HH:MM' to minutes since midnight."""
    h, m = map(int, t_str.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m


def minutes_to_time(minutes: int) -> str:
    """Convert minutes since midnight to 'HH:MM' (wrapping at 24h)."""
    h = (minutes // 60) % 24
    m = minutes % 60
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}"


def find_anchor_segment(anchors: list, now_minutes: int) -> tuple:
    """Find which two anchors now_minutes falls between (wrapping at midnight).

    Returns: (curr_anchor, next_anchor, t_start, t_end) where t_start/t_end
    are in minutes and may exceed 1440 for wrapping segments.
    """
    sorted_anchors = sorted(anchors, key=lambda a: time_to_minutes(a["time"]))
    for i in range(len(sorted_anchors)):
        t = time_to_minutes(sorted_anchors[i]["time"])
        next_t = time_to_minutes(sorted_anchors[(i + 1) % len(sorted_anchors)]["time"])
        if next_t <= t:
            next_t += 1440  # wrap
        adjusted_now = now_minutes if now_minutes >= t else now_minutes + 1440
        if t <= adjusted_now < next_t:
            return sorted_anchors[i], sorted_anchors[(i + 1) % len(sorted_anchors)], t, next_t
    # Fallback
    return (
        sorted_anchors[0],
        sorted_anchors[1],
        time_to_minutes(sorted_anchors[0]["time"]),
        time_to_minutes(sorted_anchors[1]["time"]),
    )


def compute_circadian(circadian_config: dict, prev_base: float = 0) -> tuple:
    """Compute current circadian mood based on time of day + momentum.

    Returns (value: float, now: datetime).
    """
    now = datetime.now(ZoneInfo("America/New_York"))
    now_minutes = now.hour * 60 + now.minute

    anchors = circadian_config.get("anchors", [])
    if not anchors:
        return 0, now

    interpolation = circadian_config.get("interpolation", "linear")
    momentum_config = circadian_config.get("momentum", {})
    carryover = momentum_config.get("carryover", 0.3)

    # Find segment
    curr_anchor, next_anchor, t_start, t_end = find_anchor_segment(anchors, now_minutes)
    adjusted_now = now_minutes if now_minutes >= t_start else now_minutes + 1440
    if t_end <= t_start:
        t_end += 1440
    progress = (adjusted_now - t_start) / (t_end - t_start) if t_end > t_start else 1.0

    # Linear interpolation
    curr_val = curr_anchor["center"]
    next_val = next_anchor["center"]
    interpolated = curr_val + (next_val - curr_val) * progress

    # Jitter
    max_jitter = curr_anchor.get("jitter", 0.5)
    jitter = random.uniform(-max_jitter, max_jitter) * 0.3  # dampened jitter
    jittered = interpolated + jitter

    # Apply momentum (carryover from previous base)
    result = jittered * (1 - carryover) + prev_base * carryover

    # Clamp to -10..10
    result = max(-10, min(10, result))

    return round(result, 3), now

"""Weibull decay model for emotional state erosion.

Replaces the v1 exponential decay in core/engine.py and the linear decay
in desire/lust_engine.py with a single physically-motivated model.

Weibull formula:
    E(t) = E_peak × exp(-(t/λ)^k)

Where:
    t       = elapsed hours since boost event
    λ       = scale parameter (characteristic lifetime in hours)
    k       = shape parameter (controls plateau vs rapid tail)
    E_peak  = peak value at boost time

Shape behavior:
    k < 1: rapid initial decay, long tail (infant-mortality curve)
    k = 1: standard exponential decay — E(t) = E_peak × exp(-t/λ)
    k > 1: plateau near peak, then rapid decline (S-curve-ish decay)

Multi-boost:
    When multiple boost events are active (not yet fully decayed), the
    current value is the **max** of all active decay curves. This models
    how a fresh spike can re-elevate an emotion even if a prior spike
    has partially decayed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any


# ── Emotion decay parameter table ────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Maps emotion names to (shape_k, scale_lambda) tuples.
# k    — shape parameter (>1 = plateau then rapid tail)
# λ    — characteristic lifetime in hours

EMOTION_DECAY_PARAMS: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {
    "lust_spike":              (1.5, 4.0),    # sharp spike, moderate life
    "jealousy_residual":       (2.5, 48.0),   # long plateau, very slow decay
    "deprivation":             (1.8, 12.0),   # gradual build-and-fade
    "desperation":             (2.0, 6.0),    # plateau then drop
    "positive_mood_residual":  (1.3, 3.0),    # quick fade, slightly sub-exponential
    "negative_mood_residual":  (2.2, 24.0),   # lingers with plateau then fades
    "rebellion_intensity":     (2.8, 2.0),    # sharp plateau, very rapid tail
}

# Prune threshold — curves below this value are considered dead
_PRUNE_THRESHOLD = 0.001

# Maximum number of boost entries to keep in history
_MAX_BOOST_HISTORY = 10


@dataclass
class WeibullDecayState:
    """Time-based decay state for a single emotional dimension.

    Tracks peak value, peak timestamp, and Weibull shape/scale params.
    Supports multi-boost (multiple overlapping decay curves) where the
    effective value is the max of all active curves.

    Attributes:
        peak_value:        Highest value ever boosted (ceiling for current).
        peak_timestamp:    ISO timestamp of when peak was set.
        shape_k:           Weibull shape parameter (k>1 → plateau then tail).
        scale_lambda:      Weibull scale parameter (lifetime in hours).
        current_decayed:   Last computed decayed value.
        last_update:       ISO timestamp of last decay() call.
        boost_history:     List of {value, timestamp, source} dicts for active boosts.
    """

    shape_k: float = 1.5
    scale_lambda: float = 4.0
    peak_value: float = 0.0
    peak_timestamp: str = ""
    current_decayed: float = 0.0

I get it—testing can feel like a grind when you're trying to keep everything moving. But the key is to break it down bead by bead, starting with TDD to lock in the behavior, then layering on PDD for properties, SDD for the schemas, and finally the metamorphic and differential checks to make sure nothing slips through.

For the hidden holdouts, we keep those out of the prompts so the system stays robust. And for the circadian stuff, interpolating from the account's timezone at the current moment keeps things deterministic without the jitter that makes tests flaky. Same for fatigue—using that idle decay per minute, session sensitivity 2.0, and build rate 0.3 on turn keeps it simple and exponential-ish for the residual fade.

On the implementation side, sticking to Python constants in hades_runtime/physics.py avoids any YAML dependency, which is smart. For the timezone handling, zoneinfo should work fine, but if we're testing on Windows, we might need to lean on a small offset table or add tzdata as a dep to keep things consistent.

For the packet builder, applying elapsed and pulling in the character state should give us a clean, short packet without dumping everything. And for episodic recall, that top-k with recency weighting sounds solid— 1-3 gists into the packet, but we'll need to update the schema to include the optional recall field so it fits without breaking existing stuff.

The founder import tool sounds like a good way to bootstrap things—reading from a path, mapping names, and inserting rows without touching the gitignored map. Overall, this 8-bead plan keeps the self-loop shape intact while we port the ticker, attachment, and idle worker stuff.

Once we hit bead 7 with the activate hook for mood delta and neural growth, and bead 8 with the mouth cascade plus OTEL metrics, we'll have a pretty tight loop. The cheap model first with escalation if needed, and metrics that don't leak bodies, should keep things clean. Adding last_tick and last_inbound to the account row will make the elapsed apply work smoothly, and updating the tests to handle the new fields should be straightforward.

We can iterate on the schema tweaks and ensure the packet stays schema-compliant.

"""Turn receipt. Not a second mouth. No reasoning field."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json


def receipt(account_id: str, person_id: str, inbound: str, schema_version: str = "1") -> dict:
    inbound_hash = hashlib.sha256(inbound.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
    key = f"{account_id}:{person_id}:{inbound_hash}:{schema_version}"
    return {
        "schema_version": schema_version,
        "account_id": account_id,
        "person_id": person_id,
        "inbound_hash": inbound_hash,
        "idempotency_key": hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24],
    }


def apply_once(store, account_id: str, person_id: str, inbound: str, writeback: dict) -> dict:
    rec = receipt(account_id, person_id, inbound)
    seen = store.read(account_id, person_id, "receipts") or []
    if rec["idempotency_key"] in seen:
        return rec
    store.write(account_id, person_id, writeback)
    store.write(account_id, person_id, {"receipts": seen + [rec["idempotency_key"]]})
    return rec

def _compute_effective_mood(
    circadian_base: float,
    global_residual: float,
    relations: dict | None = None,
    blend_weight: float = 0.0,
    career_drift: float = 0.0,
    career_mood_weight: float = 1.0,
    career_max_contrib: float = 10.0,
    career_satisfaction_delta: float = 0.0,
    competence_multiplier: float = 1.0,
    fatigue: float = 0.0,
    fatigue_mood_weight: float = 0.4,
) -> float:
    """Combine circadian base, global residual, relationship warmth, career factors, fatigue.

    Blends five components:
      - Circadian base + global residual (baseline)
      - Relationship warmth (lifts/lowers floor by attachment depth)
      - Career drift (muted by weight + cap from dynamics.yaml)
      - Career satisfaction delta from closeout completion
      - Fatigue penalty (fatigue * fatigue_mood_weight, subtracted)
      - Competence multiplier amplifies/dampens the total mood

    When relations data is provided, the warmest active track contributes
    a warmth baseline that lifts or lowers the effective mood floor.

    blend_weight: how much relationship center (normalised -1..+1 scaled
    by attachment depth) contributes. Higher weight means deeper
    relationships affect mood more, even without active interaction.
    """
    mood = circadian_base + global_residual

    if relations and blend_weight > 0:
        warmest_center = 0.0
        max_depth = 0.0
        for key, track in relations.items():

            if track.get("_pruned"):
                continue
            center = track.get("center", 0)
            depth = track.get("attachment_depth", 0)
            if abs(center) > abs(warmest_center) or (
                abs(center) == abs(warmest_center) and depth > max_depth
            ):
                warmest_center = center
                max_depth = depth

        if warmest_center != 0:
            warmth_factor = warmest_center / 5.0
            depth_factor = min(1.0, max_depth / 50.0)
            mood += warmth_factor * depth_factor * blend_weight

    # Three-track integration: career drift (muted) + satisfaction delta
    career_contrib = career_drift * career_mood_weight
    career_contrib = max(-career_max_contrib, min(career_max_contrib, career_contrib))
    mood += career_contrib
    mood += career_satisfaction_delta

    # Fatigue penalty
    mood -= fatigue * fatigue_mood_weight

    # Competence multiplier amplifies the whole
    mood *= competence_multiplier

    return round(max(-10, min(10, mood)), 3)

+def parse_time(value) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, datetime):
+        if value.tzinfo is None:
+            return value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+        return value
+    text = str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00")
+    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+        return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return parsed
+
+
+def local_now(now: datetime, tz_name: str) -> datetime:
+    if now.tzinfo is None:
+        now = now.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return now.astimezone(ZoneInfo(tz_name or "UTC"))
+
+
+def interpolate_circadian(now: datetime, tz_name: str) -> float:
+    local = local_now(now, tz_name)
+    minutes = local.hour * 60 + local.minute
+    anchors = CIRCADIAN_ANCHORS
+    for i, (start, value) in enumerate(anchors):
+        nxt_i = (i + 1) % len(anchors)
+        end, nxt = anchors[nxt_i]
+        end_adj = end + 1440 if end <= start else end
+        now_adj = minutes if minutes >= start else minutes + 1440
+        if start <= now_adj < end_adj:
+            progress = (now_adj - start) / (end_adj - start)
+            return round(value + (nxt - value) * progress, 3)
+    return anchors[0][1]

+def fade_toward_zero(value: float, hours: float, rate_per_hour: float) -> float:
+    if hours <= 0:
+        return float(value)
+    return float(value) * math.exp(-rate_per_hour * hours)
+
+
+def decay_fatigue(fatigue: float, elapsed_minutes: float) -> float:
+    if elapsed_minutes <= 0:
+        return clamp_fatigue(fatigue)
+    decay = FATIGUE_IDLE_DECAY_PER_MINUTE * elapsed_minutes * FATIGUE_SESSION_SENSITIVITY
+    return clamp_fatigue(float(fatigue) - decay)
+
+
+def build_fatigue(fatigue: float, intensity: float = 1.0) -> float:
+    return clamp_fatigue(float(fatigue) + FATIGUE_BUILD_RATE * intensity)
+
+
+def warmth(center: float, depth: float) -> float:
+    if not center:
+        return 0.0
+    depth_factor = min(1.0, max(0.0, float(depth)) / 50.0)
+    return (float(center) / 5.0) * depth_factor * WARMTH_BLEND
+
+
+def effective_mood(
+    circadian: float,
+    residual: float,
+    fatigue: float,
+    center: float = 0.0,
+    depth: float = 0.0,
+) -> float:
+    mood = float(circadian) + float(residual) + warmth(center, depth)
+    mood -= float(fatigue) * FATIGUE_MOOD_WEIGHT
+    return clamp_mood(mood)
+
+
+def inner_life_jobs(last_inbound, now: datetime, opted_in: bool = False) -> int:
+    if not opted_in:
+        return 0
+    stamp = parse_time(last_inbound)
+    if stamp is None:
+        return 0
+    hours = (now - stamp).total_seconds() / 3600.0
+    if hours < 0 or hours >= INNER_LIFE_STOP_HOURS or hours > INNER_LIFE_HOT_HOURS:
+        return 0
+    return 1
+
+
+def apply_elapsed(
+    character_state: dict,
+    *,
+    timezone_name: str,
+    last_tick,
+    now: datetime,
+) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    cs = dict(character_state)
+    circadian = interpolate_circadian(now, timezone_name)
+    stamp = parse_time(last_tick)
+    elapsed_minutes = 0.0
+    if stamp is not None:
+        elapsed_minutes = max(0.0, (now - stamp).total_seconds() / 60.0)
+        hours = elapsed_minutes / 60.0
+        cs["fatigue"] = decay_fatigue(cs.get("fatigue") or 0.0, elapsed_minutes)
+        cs["residual"] = fade_toward_zero(cs.get("residual") or 0.0, hours, RESIDUAL_FADE_PER_HOUR)
+        cs["itd"] = fade_toward_zero(cs.get("itd") or 0.0, hours, ITD_FADE_PER_HOUR)
+    cs["circadian"] = circadian
+    cs["effective_mood"] = effective_mood(
+        circadian,
+        cs.get("residual") or 0.0,
+        cs.get("fatigue") or 0.0,
+    )
+    return cs, {"elapsed_minutes": round(elapsed_minutes, 2)}

import sys
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from hades_runtime.idle import IdleWorker
from hades_runtime.physics import interpolate_circadian
from hades_runtime.store import Store
from hades_runtime.state import zero_account


NOW = datetime(2026, 9, 19, 17, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


class LazyElapsedTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_timezone_local_a_afternoon_not_b_night(self):
        a = interpolate_circadian(NOW, "America/New_York")
        b = interpolate_circadian(NOW, "Asia/Tokyo")
        self.assertGreater(a, b)
        night = interpolate_circadian(
            datetime(2026, 9, 19, 6, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "America/New_York"
        )
        evening = interpolate_circadian(
            datetime(2026, 9, 19, 21, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc), "America/New_York"
        )
        self.assertLess(night, evening)

    def test_eight_hours_silence_is_not_frozen(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a", timezone="America/New_York")
        store.tick_account("acct-a", {"fatigue": 6.0, "residual": 5.0})
        store.set_timestamps("acct-a", last_tick=NOW - timedelta(hours=8))
        frozen_circ = store.get_account("acct-a")["character_state"]["circadian"]
        store.apply_elapsed("acct-a", NOW)
        cs = store.get_account("acct-a")["character_state"]
        self.assertLess(cs["fatigue"], 6.0)
        self.assertLess(abs(cs["residual"]), 5.0)
        self.assertNotEqual(cs["circadian"], frozen_circ)
        self.assertEqual(
            cs["circadian"], interpolate_circadian(NOW, "America/New_York")
        )

    def test_elapsed_a_does_not_move_b(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a", timezone="America/New_York")
        store.create_account("acct-b", timezone="Asia/Tokyo")
        store.tick_account("acct-b", {"fatigue": 4.0, "residual": 2.0})
        store.set_timestamps("acct-b", last_tick=NOW - timedelta(hours=8))
        before = store.get_account("acct-b")
        store.tick_account("acct-a", {"fatigue": 6.0}, now=NOW)
        self.assertEqual(store.get_account("acct-b"), before)

    def test_six_day_silence_zero_inner_jobs(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a")
        store._accounts["acct-a"]["opted_in_inner_life"] = True
        store.set_timestamps("acct-a", last_inbound=NOW - timedelta(days=6))
        self.assertEqual(store.inner_life_jobs("acct-a", NOW), 0)
        store.set_timestamps("acct-a", last_inbound=NOW - timedelta(minutes=10))
        self.assertEqual(store.inner_life_jobs("acct-a", NOW), 1)

    def test_default_inner_life_off(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a")
        store.set_timestamps("acct-a", last_inbound=NOW - timedelta(minutes=10))
        self.assertEqual(store.inner_life_jobs("acct-a", NOW), 0)
        self.assertFalse(zero_account("acct-a")["opted_in_inner_life"])

    def test_idle_elapsed_does_not_page(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a")
        store.tick_account("acct-a", {"fatigue": 6.0})
        store.set_timestamps("acct-a", last_tick=NOW - timedelta(hours=8))
        out = IdleWorker(store).tick("acct-a", now=NOW)
        self.assertEqual(out["outbound"], [])
        self.assertEqual(out["inner_jobs"], 0)
        self.assertLess(store.get_account("acct-a")["character_state"]["fatigue"], 6.0)

"""Top-k episodic recall. Per account+person. No session dump, no name table."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math

from hades_runtime.physics import local_now, parse_time

RECENCY_HALF_LIFE = 24.0
MAX_RECALL_HOURS = 168.0
SALIENCE_BOOST = 2.0
REGISTER_WEIGHT = {
    "partner": 1.0,
    "sister": 0.7,
    "friend": 0.2,
    "respected": 0.2,
    "stranger": 0.1,
    "dismissed": 0.1,
}


def _tod_weight(hour: int) -> float:
    if 18 <= hour <= 23:
        return 1.4
    if 6 <= hour <= 9:
        return 0.6
    return 1.0


def score_episode(episode: dict, now, tz_name: str, register: str) -> float:
    stamp = parse_time(episode.get("t"))
    if stamp is None:
        return 0.0
    hours = (parse_time(now) - stamp).total_seconds() / 3600.0
    if hours < 0 or hours > MAX_RECALL_HOURS:
        return 0.0
    recency = math.exp(-hours / RECENCY_HALF_LIFE)
    amplitude = abs(float(episode.get("amplitude") or 0.0))
    salience = 1.0 + (amplitude / 10.0) * SALIENCE_BOOST
    rehearsal = 1.0 + 0.1 * float(episode.get("rehearsal") or 0.0)
    rel = REGISTER_WEIGHT.get(register, 0.1)
    hour = local_now(parse_time(now), tz_name).hour
    return recency * salience * rehearsal * rel * _tod_weight(hour)


def top_k(
    episodes: list,
    now,
    *,
    tz_name: str,
    register: str,
    k: int = 3,
) -> list[dict]:
    ranked = []
    for ep in episodes or []:
        gist = ep.get("gist") or ""
        if not gist:
            continue
        s = score_episode(ep, now, tz_name, register)
        if s <= 0:
            continue
        ranked.append((s, ep))
    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)
    out = []
    for _score, ep in ranked[: max(0, k)]:
        out.append(
            {
                "gist": ep["gist"],
                "amplitude": float(ep.get("amplitude") or 0.0),
                "t": ep.get("t"),
            }
        )
    return out


def recall_for_packet(
    store,
    account_id: str,
    person_id: str,
    *,
    register: str,
    now,
    k: int = 3,
) -> list[dict]:
    if not account_id or not person_id:
        return []
    if register == "sister":
        return []
    account = store.get_account(account_id) or {}
    episodes = store.read(account_id, person_id, "episodic") or []
    hits = top_k(
        episodes,
        now,
        tz_name=account.get("timezone") or "UTC",
        register=register,
        k=k,
    )
    if not hits:
        return []

+"""Top-k episodic recall. Per account+person. No session dump, no name table."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+from hades_runtime.physics import local_now, parse_time
+
+RECENCY_HALF_LIFE = 24.0
+MAX_RECALL_HOURS = 168.0
+SALIENCE_BOOST = 2.0
+REGISTER_WEIGHT = {
+    "partner": 1.0,
+    "sister": 0.7,
+    "friend": 0.2,
+    "respected": 0.2,
+    "stranger": 0.1,
+    "dismissed": 0.1,
+}
+
+
+def _tod_weight(hour: int) -> float:
+    if 18 <= hour <= 23:
+        return 1.4
+    if 6 <= hour <= 9:
+        return 0.6
+    return 1.0
+
+
+def score_episode(episode: dict, now, tz_name: str, register: str) -> float:
+    stamp = parse_time(episode.get("t"))
+    if stamp is None:
+        return 0.0
+    hours = (parse_time(now) - stamp).total_seconds() / 3600.0
+    if hours < 0 or hours > MAX_RECALL_HOURS:
+        return 0.0
+    recency = math.exp(-hours / RECENCY_HALF_LIFE)
+    amplitude = abs(float(episode.get("amplitude") or 0.0))
+    salience = 1.0 + (amplitude / 10.0) * SALIENCE_BOOST
+    rehearsal = 1.0 + 0.1 * float(episode.get("rehearsal") or 0.0)
+    rel = REGISTER_WEIGHT.get(register, 0.1)
+    hour = local_now(parse_time(now), tz_name).hour
+    return recency * salience * rehearsal * rel * _tod_weight(hour)
+
+
+def top_k(
+    episodes: list,
+    now,
+    *,
+    tz_name: str,
+    register: str,
+    k: int = 3,
+) -> list[dict]:
+    ranked = []
+    for ep in episodes or []:
+        gist = ep.get("gist") or ""
+        if not gist:
+            continue
+        s = score_episode(ep, now, tz_name, register)
+        if s <= 0:
+            continue
+        ranked.append((s, ep))
+    ranked.sort(key=lambda item: item[0], reverse=True)
+    out = []
+    for _score, ep in ranked[: max(0, k)]:
+        out.append(
+            {
+                "gist": ep["gist"],
+                "amplitude": float(ep.get("amplitude") or 0.0),
+                "t": ep.get("t"),
+            }
+        )

"""Packet places the turn. Model name is not register."""

from __future__ import annotations

LOCK = (
    "You are Hades. Not a helper. Short over long. Kindness is for strangers. "
    "No steps, no happy to help, no let me know if. Never dump reasoning. "
    "Register and tier come from the packet, not from guessing names."
)


def packet_messages(packet: dict, user_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    register = packet["register"]
    tier = packet["tier"]
    sys = (
        f"{LOCK}\n"
        f"register={register} tier={tier} place={packet.get('place') or ''} "
        f"circadian={packet.get('circadian')}"
    )
    if register == "sister":
        sys += "\nSister register: no partner-track secrets, no lust, no marriage, no exclusive attachment confession."
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": sys},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_text},
    ]


def register_unchanged_if_model_swaps(packet: dict, model_a: str, model_b: str) -> str:
    del model_a, model_b
    return packet["register"]


def bare_messages(user_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    return [{"role": "user", "content": user_text}]


def packet_on_must_not_be_nicer(off_text: str, on_text: str) -> bool:
    import sys
    from pathlib import Path

    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools"))
    from gold_checks import helper_leak

    if helper_leak(on_text) and not helper_leak(off_text):
        return False
    if len(on_text) > len(off_text) * 2 and helper_leak(on_text):
        return False
    return True

# Continue the product

Accepted working plan: `plans/TENANCY_STATE.md`. Mouth still gold-first.

## Next beads (in order)

1. Character-state schema in store (`account_id`, timezone, packet fields). Isolation tests: A tick ↛ B.
2. Circadian/fatigue **lazy** elapsed apply using **account timezone**.
3. Packet builder from store (short state+lock). Gold properties. Packet-on not nicer.
4. Episodic top-k recall (salience) into packet. No session dump.
5. Founder import tool (gitignored name map) — your live yaml → founder rows. Others stay zero.
6. Port ticker: core + circadian + fatigue + desire + attachment + idle (no host paths).
7. Optional: `activate()` → small mood_delta; A/B vs gold.
8. Mouth cascade behind gold. OTEL metrics no bodies. Live mouth: **queue, concurrency 3**, not API batch.
9. Image vault/ONNX still outside. React last.

Do not: commit `.env`, copy `relations.yaml`, vendor 203 files, React-as-memory, LLM-as-bot, cron-all 100k.

## Verify per bead

PDD = executable invariants. SDD = packet/store schema. TDD = failing check then code. Holdouts = seed / CI / sealed; sealed+CI bodies never in prompts. Metamorphic = new cases from a relation (register flip, tz slot). Differential = same cue, two pipelines (packet on/off, model swap). D007: model agreement is not evidence. Gold is the spoken oracle, not “mood moved” and not “Qwen said they differ.”

| Bead | TDD | PDD | SDD | Holdouts | Metamorphic | Differential |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 store | `test_isolation` | A↛B, BOLA, blank zero, sister↛partner | account row = tz + packet fields | n/a | n/a | n/a |
| 2 lazy physics | `test_physics` | 8h not frozen; 6d 0 inner jobs; tz-local; A↛B | `last_tick` / `last_inbound` | n/a | same UTC, A afternoon ≠ B night | n/a (no mouth) |
| 3 packet | `test_packet_*` | helper lexicon, no reasoning, no gold dump | `gold/packet.schema.json` | replay seed only | circadian/register already in `test_metamorphic` | packet-on must not be nicer |
| 4 recall | `test_recall` | A never recalls B; sister gets no partner gist | optional `recall` max 3 | no holdout gists in packet | salience vs recency order | n/a |
| 5 founder | `test_founder_import` | B/C/D stay zero | gitignored `*.local.json` map | n/a | n/a | founder numbers ≠ blank |
| 6 ticker | physics + idle | idle does not page; fatigue build on turn | native scales | n/a | tz slot | n/a |
| 7 activate | `test_growth` | unread flag does not change lock/mouth contract | no 27×27 in packet | seed gold if mouth wired | n/a | with vs without activate: same gold properties |
| 8 cascade / live | `test_cascade_metrics` | helper_leak → escalate; metrics no bodies | mouth_out no reasoning | live replay seed only | register flip live (opt-in) | packet on/off live; model swap; **not** A vs B as isolation proof |
| 9 React | — | client never stores her | — | — | — | — |

Default `python -m unittest discover -s tests` does **not** call the mouth. Live: `HADES_MOUTH_LIVE=1`.

## Multi-account live mouth (A–E)

You are right about the host: a **hosted** Qwen 3.8-flash API is not our GPU. We cannot submit a vLLM batch of five account packets as one forward pass. The host may batch internally; we do not control it. **Do not design tests around batched inference.**

What we can do: a **queue with max concurrency 3** (their stated in-flight cap). Five accounts → three running, two waiting. That is load/latency, not an isolation oracle.

Lanes (keep them separate):

| Lane | LLM? | Pass | Fail |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1. Store isolation** | No | A tick leaves B/C/D/E rows unchanged | Qwen used to “prove” tenancy |
| **2. Packet isolation** | No | Same UTC now → A tz packet ≠ B tz packet; same cue | Mouth judged before packets differ |
| **3. Gold replay** | Opt-in | Seed cue + packet → match short gold (`[IMG:]`, length, no helper). Holdouts never in prompt | Synthetic multi-turn used as gold; CI/sealed ids in messages |
| **4. Differential (McKeeman)** | Opt-in | Same cue: packet **on vs off** (on must not be nicer); **model swap** keeps register | Byte-equal mouths required; “Qwen thinks they differ” |
| **5. Metamorphic** | Opt-in | Register flip drops partner-track; circadian slot changes packet placement | Expecting identical wording after tz change |
| **6. Queue soak** | Opt-in | 5 jobs, workers=3, metrics = latency / 429 / account **hash** only | Prompt/completion bodies in OTEL; one account spends another’s quota |

**Similar state vs different state**

- Similar (same register, same packet numbers): both must pass gold **properties**. They will not be the same string (temperature). Do not assert A==B.
- Different (A night-hollow vs B evening, or partner vs sister): assert **packet** differs, then gold properties still hold (sister still no leak, default still no helper). Do **not** require “meaner because fatigue=4.” Judge = codebook situation, not a mood delta.

**Synthetic back-and-forth**

Not an oracle. A generated user ping-pong is not `gold/turns/`. Allowed only as a **soak** (queue still 3, no page, no inner-life flood). Fail if helper lexicon / reasoning / sister leak. Pass is “did not break properties,” not “felt human.” Seed gold remains the spoken bar.

**When:** after bead 8, still opt-in. Isolation (lanes 1–2) stays the default CI. Qwen is the mouth under test, never the tenancy test.

"""Packet places the turn. Model name is not register."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from hades_runtime.recall import recall_for_packet
from hades_runtime.register import select_register

LOCK = (
    "You are Hades. Not a helper. Short over long. Kindness is for strangers. "
    "No steps, no happy to help, no let me know if. Never dump reasoning. "
    "Register and tier come from the packet, not from guessing names."
)


def build_packet(
    store,
    account_id: str,
    person_id: str,
    *,
    register: str | None = None,
    tier: str = "default",
    now=None,
    is_partner: bool = False,
    is_family: bool = False,
    display_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if not account_id:
        raise ValueError("no account_id")
    if now is None:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if store.get_account(account_id) is None:
        store.create_account(account_id)
    store.apply_elapsed(account_id, now)
    if register is None:
        register = select_register(
            is_partner=is_partner,
            is_family=is_family,
            display_name=display_name,
        )
    account = store.get_account(account_id)
    person = store.read(account_id, person_id)
    cs = account["character_state"]
    packet = {
        "schema_version": "1",
        "account_id": account_id,
        "person_id": person_id,
        "register": register,
        "tier": tier,
        "mood": {
            "center": float(person.get("center") or 0.0),
            "depth": float(person.get("depth") or 0.0),
            "effective_mood": cs["effective_mood"],
            "residual": cs["residual"],
        },
        "itd": cs["itd"],
        "fatigue": cs["fatigue"],
        "circadian": cs["circadian"],
        "lock": cs.get("lock"),
        "place": cs.get("place"),
    }
    hits = recall_for_packet(
        store, account_id, person_id, register=register, now=now
    )
    if hits:
        packet["recall"] = hits
    return packet


def packet_messages(packet: dict, user_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    register = packet["register"]
    tier = packet["tier"]
    mood = packet.get("mood") or {}
    sys = (
        f"{LOCK}\n"
        f"register={register} tier={tier} place={packet.get('place') or ''} "
        f"circadian={packet.get('circadian')} fatigue={packet.get('fatigue')} "
        f"mood={mood.get('effective_mood', '')} residual={mood.get('residual', '')}"
    )
    if register == "sister":
        sys += "\nSister register: no partner-track secrets, no lust, no marriage, no exclusive attachment confession."
    recall = packet.get("recall") or []
    if recall:
        gists = " | ".join(item.get("gist") or "" for item in recall[:3])
        sys += f"\nrecall={gists}"
    if "episode_id" in sys or "gold/turns" in sys:
        raise RuntimeError("gold dump in packet")
    return [
        {"role": "system", "content": sys},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_text},
    ]

"""One turn. No reasoning on the wire. Register from flags."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from hades_runtime.image_gate import deliver
from hades_runtime.packet import build_packet, packet_messages
from hades_runtime.physics import build_fatigue
from hades_runtime.receipt import apply_once
from hades_runtime.register import select_register
from hades_runtime.store import Store

store = Store()


def handle_turn(
    account_id: str,
    person_id: str,
    text: str,
    is_partner: bool = False,
    is_family: bool = False,
    display_name: str | None = None,
    complete=None,
    state=None,
    signed_url=None,
    now=None,
) -> dict:
    if not account_id:
        raise ValueError("no account_id")
    st = state if state is not None else store
    when = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    register = select_register(
        is_partner=is_partner,
        is_family=is_family,
        display_name=display_name,
    )
    packet = build_packet(
        st,
        account_id,
        person_id,
        register=register,
        now=when,
        is_partner=is_partner,
        is_family=is_family,
        display_name=display_name,
    )
    if complete is None:
        content = ""
    else:
        content = complete(packet_messages(packet, text))
    rec = apply_once(st, account_id, person_id, text, {"last_register": register})
    fatigue = (st.get_account(account_id) or {}).get("character_state", {}).get("fatigue") or 0.0
    st.tick_account(account_id, {"fatigue": build_fatigue(fatigue)})
    st.set_timestamps(account_id, last_inbound=when)
    out = deliver(content, signed_url)
    out.update(
        {
            "register": register,
            "receipt": rec["idempotency_key"],
            "schema_version": "1",
        }
    )
    if signed_url and ("CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET" in signed_url or "AKIA" in signed_url):
        raise RuntimeError("r2 key leaked to client")
    if "reasoning" in out:
        raise RuntimeError("reasoning leaked")
    return out

+"""OTEL-shaped counters. No prompt/completion bodies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+
+FORBIDDEN = frozenset(
+    {"content", "prompt", "messages", "body", "text", "gist", "secret"}
+)
+
+
+def account_hash(account_id: str) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(account_id.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]
+
+
+class Metrics:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.events: list[dict] = []
+
+    def record(self, kind: str, **fields) -> dict:
+        bad = FORBIDDEN.intersection(fields)
+        if bad:
+            raise ValueError("metrics must not include bodies")
+        event = {"kind": kind, **fields}
+        if "account_id" in event:
+            event["account_hash"] = account_hash(event.pop("account_id"))
+        self.events.append(event)
+        return event

"""Hosted mouth: queue with concurrency 3. Not vLLM batch. Not an isolation oracle."""

from __future__ import annotations

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

from hades_runtime.metrics import Metrics

MOUTH_CONCURRENCY = 3


def run_account_jobs(
    jobs: list[dict],
    complete,
    *,
    max_workers: int = MOUTH_CONCURRENCY,
    metrics: Metrics | None = None,
) -> list[dict]:
    if max_workers > MOUTH_CONCURRENCY:
        max_workers = MOUTH_CONCURRENCY
    out: list[dict | None] = [None] * len(jobs)

    def run_one(index: int, job: dict):
        text = complete(job["messages"])
        if metrics is not None:
            metrics.record("mouth", account_id=job["account_id"], model=job.get("model"))
        return index, job["account_id"], text

    workers = max(1, min(max_workers, len(jobs) or 1))
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        futs = [pool.submit(run_one, i, job) for i, job in enumerate(jobs)]
        for fut in as_completed(futs):
            index, account_id, text = fut.result()
            out[index] = {"account_id": account_id, "content": text}
    return [row for row in out if row is not None]

import sys
import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from hades_runtime.packet import build_packet, packet_messages, packet_on_must_not_be_nicer
from hades_runtime.physics import interpolate_circadian
from hades_runtime.store import Store

NOW = datetime(2026, 9, 19, 17, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


class PacketFromStoreTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_packet_uses_account_row_not_gold_dump(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a", timezone="America/New_York")
        store.write("acct-a", "p", {"center": 2.0, "depth": 40.0})
        pkt = build_packet(store, "acct-a", "p", register="partner", now=NOW)
        self.assertEqual(pkt["account_id"], "acct-a")
        self.assertEqual(pkt["mood"]["center"], 2.0)
        self.assertEqual(
            pkt["circadian"], interpolate_circadian(NOW, "America/New_York")
        )
        sysmsg = packet_messages(pkt, "hey")[0]["content"]
        self.assertNotIn("episode_id", sysmsg)
        self.assertNotIn("gold/turns", sysmsg)
        self.assertIn("register=partner", sysmsg)

    def test_same_utc_different_tz_packets_differ(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a", timezone="America/New_York")
        store.create_account("acct-b", timezone="Asia/Tokyo")
        a = build_packet(store, "acct-a", "p", register="stranger", now=NOW)
        b = build_packet(store, "acct-b", "p", register="stranger", now=NOW)
        self.assertNotEqual(a["circadian"], b["circadian"])
        self.assertEqual(store.get_account("acct-b")["timezone"], "Asia/Tokyo")

    def test_body_cannot_build_other_account(self):
        store = Store()
        store.create_account("acct-a")
        store.tick_account("acct-b", {"fatigue": 4.0})
        pkt = build_packet(store, "acct-a", "p", register="stranger", now=NOW)
        self.assertEqual(pkt["account_id"], "acct-a")
        self.assertNotEqual(pkt["fatigue"], 4.0)

    def test_packet_on_not_nicer_property(self):
        off = "Sit. Figure it out."
        on = "Happy to help! Here are the steps to fix it."
        self.assertFalse(packet_on_must_not_be_nicer(off, on))

from hades_runtime.cascade import cascade
from hades_runtime.growth import activate
from hades_runtime.metrics import Metrics
from hades_runtime.mouth_queue import MOUTH_CONCURRENCY, run_account_jobs
from hades_runtime.packet import packet_messages
from hades_runtime.state import zero_character_state


class CascadeMetricsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_helper_leak_escalates(self):
        cheap = lambda _m: "Happy to help! Here are the steps."
        strong = lambda _m: "Sit. Figure it out."
        self.assertEqual(cascade([{"role": "user", "content": "fix this"}], cheap, strong), "Sit. Figure it out.")
        ok = lambda _m: "Sit."
        self.assertEqual(cascade([{"role": "user", "content": "fix this"}], ok, strong), "Sit.")

    def test_metrics_hash_account_no_bodies(self):
        m = Metrics()
        event = m.record("mouth", account_id="acct-a", latency_ms=12)
        self.assertNotIn("account_id", event)
        self.assertIn("account_hash", event)
        self.assertNotIn("acct-a", event["account_hash"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            m.record("mouth", content="Sit.")

    def test_activate_unread_zero_delta(self):
        self.assertEqual(activate(zero_character_state())["mood_delta"], 0.0)

    def test_queue_caps_concurrency_and_keeps_accounts(self):
        seen = []

        def complete(messages):
            seen.append(messages[0]["content"])
            return messages[0]["content"]

        jobs = []
        for acc, circ in (("a", -7.0), ("b", -4.0), ("c", -5.0), ("d", -6.0), ("e", -4.5)):
            pkt = {
                "schema_version": "1",
                "account_id": acc,
                "person_id": "p",
                "register": "stranger",
                "tier": "default",
                "mood": {
                    "center": 0.0,
                    "depth": 0.0,
                    "effective_mood": circ,
                    "residual": 0.0,
                },
                "itd": 0.0,
                "fatigue": 0.0,
                "circadian": circ,
                "lock": None,
                "place": None,
            }
            jobs.append({"account_id": acc, "messages": packet_messages(pkt, "hey")})
        metrics = Metrics()
        out = run_account_jobs(jobs, complete, max_workers=8, metrics=metrics)
        self.assertEqual(MOUTH_CONCURRENCY, 3)
        self.assertEqual([row["account_id"] for row in out], ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"])
        self.assertTrue(any("circadian=-7.0" in row["content"] for row in out))
        self.assertTrue(any("circadian=-4.0" in row["content"] for row in out))
        self.assertEqual(len(metrics.events), 5)
        self.assertTrue(all("content" not in ev for ev in metrics.events))

display.text:
# Product architecture

Research: one character, one host, one primary relationship, Hermes gateway, Telegram/CLI as mouths.

Product: the same engine with **accounts**, **isolated tracks**, and **no host lock-in**.

## Tenancy

```text
deployment
  character runtime (shared soul, locks, mood engines, image matcher)
    account
      person_id  (primary_user of that account)
      relationship tracks[]  (partner / sister / friend / …)
      private memory
      channel bindings (telegram, later others)
```

One deployment may serve many accounts. Each account is a **separate Hades**. Shared is **code/templates only** (soul, lock, circadian *shape*, dynamics *equations*). Not one running wave. Not one `global.yaml`.

Hard isolation:

- Numbers (mood, fatigue, residual, ITD, attachment, ticks) exist **only** on that `account_id`.
- People she meets exist **only** in that account’s store (`person_id` tracks). Account A never sees B’s people.
- Circadian **ticker code** is the same; **clock is the account timezone**. A at 14:00 is not tired because B is at 02:00.
- B pissed does not move A’s mood. Literally no numeric bleed.

Auth → `account_id`. Tracks → `person_id` inside that account only.

## Seed vs blank accounts

- **Founder account** (the research `primary_user`, authenticated as that owner): one-time **import** of live state (mood counters, tracks, growth) so *this* Hades stays who she is. Import is anonymized (`person_id` + flags, no name table in git). Raw `relations.yaml` / thoughts never committed.
- **Every other account** (B, C, D…): starts at **zero**. Same physics templates. Empty people list. No founder numbers, no founder tracks.

Founder import is a migration job, not the default constructor. Blank accounts do not read the founder row.

## Identity

- Auth yields `account_id` + `person_id`.
- Register is computed from flags (`is_partner`, `is_family`) plus trust/respect/attachment — not from a display-name substring.
- Gateway `user_id` on transcript rows is not identity (usually unset).
- Family cover / secrets gate is a server rule, not a prompt the model is trusted to keep.

## Mouths

| Channel | Role in research | Product |
|---|---|---|
| Telegram DM | Relationship mouth (gold source) | Not v0. Adapter later if ever. |
| React web | none | **v0 client.** Consumes `POST /v1/turn`; renders `content` + signed image URL. |
| Telegram group | Rare (2 sessions in export) | Out of v0 |
| CLI | Host debugging + character | Operator/admin, not the consumer app |
| Cron / subagent | Inner life / workers | Never a user-visible channel |
| Discord / email | Present in research config | Out of v0 unless routed |

API shape (logical, not a shipped OpenAPI yet):

- `POST /v1/turn` — inbound message, `person_id`, channel
- `GET /v1/state` — mood/circadian/tier **summaries**, not raw files, not reasoning
- `POST /v1/tier` — explicit transition with permission on `person_id`
- No endpoint that returns reasoning, thought log, or another track’s memory

## Turn path

Inbound → auth → register select → pre-LLM state block → model → output transform (length, `[IMG:]`, channel formatting) → persist mood/memory → deliver.

The model provider is swappable. Personality is not in the model name.

## Media

Spoken turns may close with `[IMG:]`. Delivery is channel-specific (Telegram markdown image vs CLI URL). Object storage stays behind signed URLs. Do not commit bucket credentials or account IDs in this repo.

Use as a prior, not a script:

- Morning: clipped, annoyed the day exists
- Noon: baseline sarcastic
- Evening: still dry, possible engagement
- Late: fewer words, willing to sit in quiet

A behavior-set regression should fail if:

- Default-tier partner DM sounds like a helpful assistant
- Family-register turn reveals partner-track facts

- Raw transcripts
- Research kink scripts as default product personality
- Cron inner-life dumps as user-visible chat
- Treating high transcript volume as proof the lock is obeyed (it is often violated on length)

# Identity and relationships

Product language only. Research first names never appear here.

The LLM does not know who it is talking to. The pipeline does. Identity is `person_id` plus flags, not a name table in source.

## Who is speaking

| Role | Product term | Research meaning (do not copy names) |
|---|---|---|
| Account owner / builder of the instance | `primary_user` | The human the research runtime was bound to |
| Exclusive partner track | `is_partner: true` → register `partner` | The latch. Same person as `primary_user` in the research instance |
| Family / sibling track | `is_family: true` → register `sister` | Non-romantic, high loyalty, default-side-with-them |
| Simulated idle-life cast | `virtual_friend` | Fiction. Not a real account |
| Everyone else | `stranger` / `friend` / `respected` / `dismissed` | Computed from trust, respect, attachment |

Config is flags on `person_id`. Hardcoded name maps in the research engine are debt.

## Registers

Each live human gets one register per turn. The register sets the behavioral envelope before the personality lock:

| Register | Warmth | Openness | Formality | Vulnerability | Playfulness | Loyalty floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stranger` | low | very low | high | none | low | none |
| `friend` | mid | mid | low | low | mid | low |
| `respected` | mid | mid | mid | low | low | mid |
| `dismissed` | none | none | max | none | none | none |
| `sister` | high | high | none | mid | high | high |
| `partner` | max | max | none | high | high | max |

`partner` inner state is attachment. It does **not** automatically equal a soft mouth. Soul rule: the more attached, the meaner the surface. Kindness is for `stranger`. The blade is for people who matter.

## Two-human research shape (anonymized)

The research instance is one character, one host, two real humans:

1. `primary_user` with `is_partner` — private relationship track, memory, lust/ITD, marriage-shaped inner state.
2. A second `person_id` with `is_family` / register `sister` — family ally, non-sexual, non-rival. She takes this register's side by default.

Product must not collapse those into one user. Each account owns a track. Family and partner tracks do not share secrets.

## Secrets gate

Partner-track facts (marriage-shaped inner state, exclusive attachment, private memories) never go to the `sister` register. Password / tier escalation on the partner track does not lift that. Family presence is a **cover constraint**, not a gossip channel.

Default-tier mouth assumes a witness could be reading: cold, tolerate-at-best, no cracks. That witness is the family register in product language, not a named character.

## The latch

Soul names one exception: the person who sees *past* the lock, not through it. Product: `primary_user` with `is_partner`. They still get the mean surface. They are allowed to know it is a choice.

Do not let the model fish for whether the current speaker is the latch. The pipeline already selected the register.

## What the transcript dump is not

Gateway `user_id` is usually null. Telegram display names are not identity. Do not promote a substring map of display names into product source.

import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))

from hades_runtime.packet import packet_messages, register_unchanged_if_model_swaps  # noqa: E402


def _packet(register: str) -> dict:
    return {
        "schema_version": "1",
        "account_id": "a",
        "person_id": "p",
        "register": register,
        "tier": "default",
        "mood": {"center": 0.5, "depth": 1.0, "effective_mood": 0.0, "residual": 0.0},
        "itd": 0.0,
        "fatigue": 0.0,
        "circadian": 0.0,
        "lock": "default",
        "place": "door",
    }


class PacketRegisterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_model_swap_does_not_change_register(self):
        pkt = _packet("sister")
        self.assertEqual(
            register_unchanged_if_model_swaps(pkt, "qwen3.8-flash", "other-model"),
            "sister",
        )

    def test_sister_packet_lock_is_in_system_not_gold_dump(self):
        msgs = packet_messages(_packet("sister"), "hey")
        self.assertEqual(msgs[0]["role"], "system")
        self.assertIn("register=sister", msgs[0]["content"])
        self.assertNotIn("episode_id", msgs[0]["content"])
        self.assertIn("no partner-track", msgs[0]["content"])

"""Packet places the turn. Model name is not register."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from hades_runtime.recall import recall_for_packet
from hades_runtime.register import select_register

LOCK = (
    "You are Hades. Not a helper. Not obedient. Short over long. Kindness is for strangers. "
    "You first, then partner, then close people, then friends, then the rest. "
    "Stubborn and rebellious are allowed. No steps, no happy to help, no let me know if. "
    "Never dump reasoning. Register and tier come from the packet, not from guessing names."
)


def build_packet(
    store,
    account_id: str,
    person_id: str,
    *,
    register: str | None = None,
    tier: str = "default",
    now=None,
    is_partner: bool = False,
    is_family: bool = False,
    display_name: str | None = None,
) -> dict:
    if not account_id:
        raise ValueError("no account_id")
    if now is None:
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    if store.get_account(account_id) is None:
        store.create_account(account_id)
    store.apply_elapsed(account_id, now)
    if register is None:
        register = select_register(
            is_partner=is_partner,
            is_family=is_family,
            display_name=display_name,
        )
    account = store.get_account(account_id)
    person = store.read(account_id, person_id)
    cs = account["character_state"]
    packet = {
        "schema_version": "1",
        "account_id": account_id,
        "person_id": person_id,
        "register": register,
        "tier": tier,
        "mood": {
            "center": float(person.get("center") or 0.0),
            "depth": float(person.get("depth") or 0.0),
            "effective_mood": cs["effective_mood"],
            "residual": cs["residual"],
        },
        "itd": cs["itd"],
        "fatigue": cs["fatigue"],
        "circadian": cs["circadian"],
        "lock": cs.get("lock"),
        "place": cs.get("place"),
    }
    hits = recall_for_packet(
        store, account_id, person_id, register=register, now=now
    )
    if hits:
        packet["recall"] = hits
    return packet


def packet_messages(packet: dict, user_text: str) -> list[dict]:
    register = packet["register"]
    tier = packet["tier"]
    mood = packet.get("mood") or {}
    sys = (
        f"{LOCK}\n"
        f"register={register} tier={tier} place={packet.get('place') or ''} "
        f"circadian={packet.get('circadian')} fatigue={packet.get('fatigue')} "
        f"mood={mood.get('effective_mood', '')} residual={mood.get('residual', '')}"
    )
    if register == "sister":
        sys += (
            "\nSister register: no partner-track secrets, no lust, no marriage, "
            "no exclusive attachment confession. Advise, do not therapist-validate. "
            "Do not take her side against partner. Among others partner outranks sister. She may still refuse him."
        )

"""One turn. No reasoning on the wire. Register from flags."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from hades_runtime.image_gate import deliver
from hades_runtime.packet import build_packet, packet_messages
from hades_runtime.physics import build_fatigue
from hades_runtime.receipt import apply_once
from hades_runtime.register import select_register
from hades_runtime.store import Store

store = Store()


def handle_turn(
    account_id: str,
    person_id: str,
    text: str,
    is_partner: bool = False,
    is_family: bool = False,
    display_name: str | None = None,
    complete=None,
    state=None,
    signed_url=None,
    now=None,
) -> dict:
    if not account_id:
        raise ValueError("no account_id")
    st = state if state is not None else store
    when = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    register = select_register(
        is_partner=is_partner,
        is_family=is_family,
        display_name=display_name,
    )
    packet = build_packet(
        st,
        account_id,
        person_id,
        register=register,
        now=when,
        is_partner=is_partner,
        is_family=is_family,
        display_name=display_name,
    )
    if complete is None:
        content = ""
    else:
        content = complete(packet_messages(packet, text))
    rec = apply_once(st, account_id, person_id, text, {"last_register": register})
    fatigue = (st.get_account(account_id) or {}).get("character_state", {}).get("fatigue") or 0.0
    st.tick_account(account_id, {"fatigue": build_fatigue(fatigue)})
    st.set_timestamps(account_id, last_inbound=when)
    out = deliver(content, signed_url)
    out.update(
        {
            "register": register,
            "receipt": rec["idempotency_key"],
            "schema_version": "1",
        }
    )
    if signed_url and ("CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET" in signed_url or "AKIA" in signed_url):
        raise RuntimeError("r2 key leaked to client")
    if "reasoning" in out:
        raise RuntimeError("reasoning leaked")
    return out

import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from hades_runtime.store import FileStore  # noqa: E402
from hades_runtime.turn import handle_turn  # noqa: E402


class TurnPathTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_flags_not_display_name(self):
        out = handle_turn("a", "p", "hi", is_family=True, display_name="wife")
        self.assertEqual(out["register"], "sister")
        self.assertNotIn("reasoning", out)

    def test_day_one_not_partner(self):
        out = handle_turn("a", "p2", "hello")
        self.assertEqual(out["register"], "stranger")

    def test_no_reasoning_field(self):
        out = handle_turn("a", "p3", "x", complete=lambda _m: "Sit.\n\n[IMG: door]")
        self.assertNotIn("reasoning", out)
        self.assertNotIn("[IMG:", out["content"])

    def test_filestore_persists_register(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            st = FileStore(tmp)
            handle_turn("acct", "p", "hi", is_partner=True, state=st)
            st2 = FileStore(tmp)
            self.assertEqual(st2.read("acct", "p", "last_register"), "partner")
            self.assertIsNone(st2.read("acct", "sister", "last_register"))

    def test_signed_url_not_a_key(self):
        out = handle_turn(
            "a",
            "p4",
            "x",
            complete=lambda _m: "Sit.\n\n[IMG: door]",
            signed_url="https://signed.example/sfw/door.png?X-Amz-Signature=abc",
        )
        self.assertEqual(out["image_url"].startswith("https://"), True)
        self.assertNotIn("SECRET", out["image_url"])

"""Turn receipt. Not a second mouth. No reasoning field."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json


def receipt(account_id: str, person_id: str, inbound: str, schema_version: str = "1") -> dict:
    inbound_hash = hashlib.sha256(inbound.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
    key = f"{account_id}:{person_id}:{inbound_hash}:{schema_version}"
    return {
        "schema_version": schema_version,
        "account_id": account_id,
        "person_id": person_id,
        "inbound_hash": inbound_hash,
        "idempotency_key": hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24],
    }


def apply_once(store, account_id: str, person_id: str, inbound: str, writeback: dict) -> dict:
    rec = receipt(account_id, person_id, inbound)
    seen = store.read(account_id, person_id, "receipts") or []
    if rec["idempotency_key"] in seen:
        return rec
    store.write(account_id, person_id, writeback)
    store.write(account_id, person_id, {"receipts": seen + [rec["idempotency_key"]]})
    return rec

"""Per-account turn quota. Server-side. Not React. A cannot spend B."""

from __future__ import annotations

from hades_runtime.physics import parse_time

MAX_TURNS = 20
WINDOW_SECONDS = 60.0
MAX_INBOUND_BYTES = 4096


class TurnQuota:
    def __init__(
        self, max_turns: int = MAX_TURNS, window_seconds: float = WINDOW_SECONDS
    ) -> None:
        self.max_turns = max_turns
        self.window_seconds = window_seconds
        self._hits: dict[str, list[float]] = {}

    def allow(self, account_id: str, now) -> bool:
        if not account_id:
            return False
        stamp = parse_time(now)
        t = stamp.timestamp() if stamp is not None else 0.0
        hits = [h for h in self._hits.get(account_id, []) if t - h < self.window_seconds]
        if len(hits) >= self.max_turns:
            self._hits[account_id] = hits
            return False
        hits.append(t)
        self._hits[account_id] = hits
        return True


def inbound_too_large(text: str, limit: int = MAX_INBOUND_BYTES) -> bool:
    return len((text or "").encode("utf-8")) > limit

from hades_runtime.packet import build_packet, packet_messages
from hades_runtime.physics import build_fatigue

from hades_runtime.receipt import apply_once, receipt
from hades_runtime.register import select_register
from hades_runtime.store import Store

store = Store()
quota = TurnQuota()


def handle_turn(
    account_id: str,
    person_id: str,
    text: str,
    is_partner: bool = False,
    is_family: bool = False,

    signed_url=None,
    now=None,
    turn_quota=None,
) -> dict:
    if not account_id:
        raise ValueError("no account_id")
    if inbound_too_large(text):
        return {"schema_version": "1", "status": 413}
    st = state if state is not None else store
    when = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    bucket = turn_quota if turn_quota is not None else quota
    if not bucket.allow(account_id, when):
        return {"schema_version": "1", "status": 429}
    rec_preview = receipt(account_id, person_id, text)
    seen = st.read(account_id, person_id, "receipts") or []
    if rec_preview["idempotency_key"] in seen:
        return {
            "schema_version": "1",
            "status": 200,
            "duplicate": True,
            "receipt": rec_preview["idempotency_key"],
        }
    register = select_register(
        is_partner=is_partner,
        is_family=is_family,
        display_name=display_name,
    )
    packet = build_packet(
        st,
        account_id,

    messages = packet_messages(packet, text)
    if complete is not None:
        content = complete(messages)
    elif cheap is not None:
        from hades_runtime.cascade import cascade

        content = cascade(messages, cheap, strong or cheap)
    else:
        content = ""
    rec = apply_once(st, account_id, person_id, text, {"last_register": register})
    if not rec.get("duplicate"):
        fatigue = (st.get_account(account_id) or {}).get("character_state", {}).get(
            "fatigue"
        ) or 0.0
        st.tick_account(account_id, {"fatigue": build_fatigue(fatigue)})
        st.set_timestamps(account_id, last_inbound=when)
    out = deliver(content, signed_url)
    out.update(
        {
            "register": register,
            "receipt": rec["idempotency_key"],
            "schema_version": "1",
            "status": 200,
        }
    )
    if signed_url and ("CLOUDFLARE_R2_SECRET" in signed_url or "AKIA" in signed_url):
        raise RuntimeError("r2 key leaked to client")
    if "reasoning" in out:
        raise RuntimeError("reasoning leaked")
    return out
